seoTitle: How to Copy a Page to Another Project in Canva
metaDescription: Copy an entire page from one Canva design and paste it into a different project while keeping all layers, formatting, and layout intact.
intro: Repurposing a successful page layout across different Canva projects doesn't mean rebuilding it from scratch. By opening both projects in separate browser tabs, you can select and copy an entire page's elements, then paste them into a new canvas while keeping the formatting intact. This guide covers the full process.

steps.heading: Open both projects in separate tabs
steps.body: Load your source design and your target project in two different browser tabs so you can move between them.

steps.heading: Navigate to the page you want to copy
steps.body: In the source project, go to the specific page containing the layout you want to replicate.

steps.heading: Select all elements on the page
steps.body: Use the canvas shortcut to select every graphic and text layer on that page at once.

steps.heading: Copy the elements to your clipboard
steps.body: Copy the selected elements so they're ready to paste into the other project.

steps.heading: Switch to the target project and add a page
steps.body: Move to the target canvas tab, add a blank page, and paste the copied layout onto it.

steps.heading: Check alignment and save
steps.body: Use the Position and Layers panel to confirm the layout stayed intact, then save your updated project.

faq.question: Will the copied page keep its exact formatting?
faq.answer: Yes, copying all layer elements as a group is designed to preserve formatting when pasted into a new project.

faq.question: Do I need two browser tabs open at once?
faq.answer: Yes, having both the source and target projects open in separate tabs makes it easier to copy and paste between them.

faq.question: Will elements automatically resize to fit a different canvas size?
faq.answer: Canva can adapt pasted elements to different canvas dimensions, but it's worth checking your layout hierarchy afterward to make sure nothing shifted unexpectedly.

faq.question: Can I copy just one element instead of the whole page?
faq.answer: Yes, instead of selecting all elements you can select individual items if you only need to bring over part of the layout.
